title: Towards Defining, Measuring, and Leveraging Creativity in AI Applications
abstract: arXiv:2610.12845v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Despite extensive research, computational creativity still lacks a conceptually grounded, practically relevant, and empirically applicable formal definition across contexts such as art, scientific research, and games. Existing approaches to creativity often focus on proposing informal conceptual definitions without providing formal computational concepts. Alternatively, they propose formal definitions without carefully examining their underlying assumptions or providing validation of these definitions by testing their performance in specific application settings. To address these problems, this paper proposes several formal postulates of creativity grounded in prior psychological work on creativity, especially as related to Boden's three core criteria of creativity: newness, value, and surprise. translated_title: 迈向在人工智能应用中定义、测量与利用创造力
translated_abstract: 尽管已有大量研究，计算创造力在艺术、科学研究和游戏等场景中仍然缺乏一个概念上有据可依、实践上相关且经验上可适用的形式化定义。现有的创造力研究方法往往要么侧重于提出非正式的概念性定义，却不提供形式化的计算概念；要么提出形式化定义，却不仔细审视其底层假设，也不通过在特定应用环境中测试其表现来验证这些定义。为解决这些问题，本文基于先前关于创造力的心理学研究，尤其是与Boden提出的创造力三大核心准则（新颖性、价值和惊奇）相关的工作，提出了若干创造力的形式化公设。此外，我们提出了一个与这些公设相一致的概念性数学创造力定义，并对所提出的创造力（定义）在……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文基于心理学创造力理论（尤其是Boden的新颖性、价值与惊奇三大准则）提出了创造力的形式化公设与数学定义，并在AI应用中对其加以验证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes formal postulates and a mathematical definition of creativity grounded in psychological theories—especially Boden's criteria of newness, value, and surprise—and validates them in AI applications.
